mentions.name: Homestead
mentions.description: This is an open-source platform for building personal apps: you build web apps and it handles the backend, agent support, authentication, notifications, and other platform functionality. It has been used to build a grocery store list, credit card perk tracker, address book, mini-golf scorecard app, and more, letting the builder focus on the app itself.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on [Homestead](https://myhomestead.dev), which is my OSS solution for building personal apps. You can build web-apps and Homestead will handle backend, agent support, authentication, notifications, and a bunch of other stuff.
